# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to one clear purpose.
- [ ] S01 remains the default delivery stage.
- [ ] Keil rebuild completes with zero errors and warnings.
- [ ] Attribution, project path, privacy, and third-party checks pass.
- [ ] OLED-visible strings remain English ASCII.
- [ ] Safety behavior and tuning documentation are updated when affected.
- [ ] No generated build products or per-user Keil files are included.
